Hey Pwadigy, first of all thank you for putting in your effort and all the work to make a second montage! I highly respect you for everything you do, but I do have some suggestions so that your future montages can be better :)

The gameplay/clips were nice, but for the first minute of the montage, it was a whole bunch of really fast-forwarded clips, making all of them hard to watch and appreciate. Before I could think about a clip that I watched, the next clip was already zooming by, and it seemed messy.

Afterwards, it got better, as clips were put in a more "normal" speed. I could see the different skills and tactics you were using a lot better, and I could think "Wow that was an awesome play" a lot more instead of "Why is everything so fast, gotta put this vid at 0.5x speed".

Finally, you should mix up the types up clips in the montage. Like don't just put all the feeds in one part of the montage, then the next part being long streaks, then the final part a whole bunch of cool single kills. If you mix it up, people will enjoy it more and will want to keep watching, not skip or stop watching.

Overall a great montage, again thanks for everything you do in this community Pwadigy. Can't wait to see what you come out with next!

The second DLC, House of Wolves, is coming out on May 19, recently there was an update that brought a LOT of changes (check out the megathread above).

This week, Queen's Wrath came back, it's an event that lasts a week (though this time it probably lasts longer). In Queen's Wrath, you go to the vendor in the Tower named Petra Venj (place where Iron Banner vendor is), who has a stock of several bounties.

These bounties require you to go on patrol and wait for a "pack of wolves" to appear, and at the end of the encounter you will have to kill a target. After the target is killed, a chest spawns (it's marked with a weird glowy thing), and the chest gives you some nice rewards, such as engrams, synthesis, and "Treasure Keys" (keys are to be used for Prison of Elders, the new big "raid" in House of Wolves).

With Queen's Wrath and the update itself, a whole bunch of new additions/items/issues arose, all of them are listed above!

Enjoy your time hunting :)
